answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7651 Country: India Title: Assalam o alaikum; we are muslim living here in new zealand I am hafiz Holy Quran i want to give travi but no hafiz here if i am not giving travih may be i forget quran what we have plan to do just some one will see in the quran in the middle of namaz if there any mistake he will help thank you Question: Assalam o alaikum; we are muslim living here in new zealand I am hafiz Holy Quran i want to give travi but no hafiz here if i am not giving travih may be i forget quran what we have plan to do just some one will see in the quran in the middle of namaz if there any mistake he will help thank you Answer ID: 7651 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1775/1486=B/1429) According to Hanfi Fiqh, while performing salah it is not right to see the Holy Quran and recite it while seeing it. If no Hafiz is available to hear, you should memorize properly and then lead taravih confidently. If any error occurs or doubt takes place, confirm it when the salah is over and rectify the mistake in the next rakah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
